telugu_title: శ్రీ అన్నపూర్ణమ్మ అమ్మ వారి దేవర మందిరము
location: Avvaru Vari Street, Chirala, Bapatla District, Andhra Pradesh – 523155
theme: Traditional Indian Temple Aesthetic + Modern Responsive UI

typography.h2_section: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-serif font-bold text-[#500000] border-b-2 border-[#C5A059] pb-2 inline-block

layout_hierarchy: 1. Mantra Ticker Marquee: Seamless RTL / LTR running text 'ఓం శ్రీ అన్నపూర్ణా దేవి' in golden ticker bar with maroon bg (#500000)

2. Unified Sacred Hero: Title artwork image directly above Ammavari deity photograph in a single antique-gold-bordered frame, ivory (#FFFAF0) background, NO black bars, deity image object-fit contain, max-width min(760px, 94vw)

3. Box-Style Navigation Cards: Individual rounded cards with ivory bg, antique-gold border, deep maroon text. Hover: maroon bg + ivory text. Active: deep maroon bg. Layout: 3 columns desktop, 2 columns mobile. Nav items: Home, About Temple, Gallery, Previous Years, Events, Committee, Avvaru Vamshavali, Location, Contact
4. Welcome / Intro Section: Temple history & spiritual significance with ornate gold arch borders and brass diya accents
7. Footer: Sacred motifs, address, contact, pooja timings, admin portal login button

features: Events Management (Upcoming and Past Events with photos & date range)
Gallery & Media Library (Image upload/URL, captions, category tag)
Committee Members CRUD (Designation, Photo, Phone, Bio)
Avvaru Vamshavali Lineage Entries CRUD (Generation, Name, Details, Family tree node)
Temple Pooja Timings & Notice Bar Editor

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-home-card', data-testid='admin-login-button')
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays; use solid ivory `#FFFAF0` or maroon `#500000` with proper opacity and blur
Strictly follow Telugu rendering standards with Google Fonts Noto Serif Telugu
All components are built as `.js` / `.jsx` files
Maintain responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop views
